canonical_requirements: OPERATOR-AUTHORITY-004 — Exact scientific and scope identities
canonical_scenarios: Claimed role paths for one credential
Three authenticated duties release approved material
Dry-run, applied renewal and terminal history
Changed retention or duration with old proof
Exact reviewed configuration and device tuple
Authorized configuration without a shipped adapter
Approval replaced while a grant is outstanding
Current grant starts before an approval retirement
Owned reader starts under current signed authority
Signing authority fails or unsigned raw choice changes
Current optical run retains descriptive evidence
Pre-start failure or relabeled camera run
Original device samples are published under current permission
Matching file hash contains forged or relabeled samples
rationale: Required implementation acceptance remains unproved. The exact unmet clauses below prevent approval after final correction 2/2. Passing shared gates and closed prior source findings do not supply those clauses. This is an evidence block, not a newly reproduced source defect.

exact_remaining_clauses.expected_observation: Normalized submission and same-version retry — - **GIVEN** a typed study body and a separately authorized submitter - **WHEN** the submitter applies its first immutable version - **THEN** the receipt exposes revision one, the exact normalized body and its canonical digest - **AND** replaying the same version fails without replacing its body or creating a second submission decision
unproved_then_clauses: “receipt exposes revision one, exact normalized body ... replay ... without ... second submission decision”: no initial receipt revision/body equality or post-replay event-count assertion; actor uses fictional local identity, not actual cloud authentication.
current_assertions_proven: Duplicate submission raises REGISTRY_VERSION_EXISTS; final released digest equals initial submitted digest and body; dry-run rolls back first version.
